intro: Texas season dates change by county and migratory-bird zone. North and South deer dates, turkey openings, waterfowl zones and county-specific antler or bag rules can all differ, so use the statewide dates as a starting point—not a substitute for the TPWD county listing.
zoneNote: TPWD’s county regulations control deer bag limits and antler restrictions; turkey seasons apply only in open counties; waterfowl and goose dates vary by zone. Verify the exact county, zone, property permit and current rules in the Outdoor Annual before hunting.

licenseAndEducation.fact: A license is required to hunt any animal, bird, frog or turtle, subject to listed exceptions. Licenses generally run through Aug. 31; new licenses go on sale Aug. 15. Confirmed prices: resident $25, youth $7, nonresident general $315, nonresident 5-day small game/exotic $48 (not valid for turkey, deer, alligator, pronghorn or bighorn sheep).
Buy online through TPWD’s license sales portal or from TPWD license retailers. Drawn hunts are online-only and require the hunter’s Customer Number, email and online payment.
The Archery Hunting Endorsement costs $7 and is required for game animals during an archery-only season and deer at any time in Collin, Dallas, Grayson or Rockwall counties.
The $7 Upland Game Bird Endorsement is required for wild turkey, pheasant, quail and chachalaca. It cannot be used to hunt turkey with the nonresident special 5-day license.

licenseAndEducation.topic: Migratory endorsement, HIP and federal stamp
licenseAndEducation.fact: The Texas Migratory Game Bird Endorsement costs $7 and is required for waterfowl, coot, rail, gallinule, snipe, dove, sandhill crane and woodcock. HIP applies. A Federal Duck Stamp costs $25 plus fulfillment and is required for waterfowl hunters age 16+.

Hunters born on or after Sept. 2, 1971 must complete hunter education. Ages 9–16 may hunt while accompanied; age 17+ may use a one-time $10 deferral while accompanied. Proof must be carried when hunting, but is not required to purchase a license. Certification minimum age is 9 and certification is for life.
Classroom and Internet+Field courses cost $15 paid to the instructor, with possible facility/range fees; online-only is for age 17+ and provider fees vary.
Digital licenses are available online; digital tag holders must use the Texas Hunt & Fish app for digital tags and keep the digital license available in the field.
